strengths: Every narrated number traces to a confirmed claim and appears in the product's own text: 67 ms and 4 dropped frames (TIME-08), 258 fetches and checkpoint -1 (TIME-11), 25 of 27 renders (TIME-08), Tue 3:00 AM America/New_York and the six real Tuesdays (CONT-02/03). None is rounded or changed, and the contested 'long task' framing (TIME-18) is avoided.

The rendered takes match the script's described content at every mark checked: the bug-react title at 3040-3200 with the dark 'Loading replay…' player, the Root Cause clause naming the non-memoized react-router Link components at 12008, the bug-sync title, the Actual card's 'while the user does nothing', the three-step chain ending '258 GETs (~600-750ms cadence, avg 631ms)', the Insights tiles 50 · 711 · 29% · 1151 · 89, and 'Running test loops automatically.' with the Active pill at 1200 (Budget value outside the crop).

The bible's traps are handled correctly: no 'nightly' over the weekly chip, 'reading-room' is never called an app, the Insights 258 never shares a frame with the 258 re-fetches, 'Insights' labels the 50 projects (not 'in the account'), the empty exploration player is covered and never called a recording, and 'Every recording gets reviewed' uses TIME-C1's recommended wording.

The illustrations are honestly labelled as ours ('illustration · …' captions on the frame ribbon and fiber grid, our own 'Discovered' labels), and the narration carries no quotation marks, so there is no quote-integrity exposure.

Narration is written for the ear: numbers are spoken naturally ('Sixty-seven milliseconds', 'two hundred fifty-eight', 'minus one'), the exact symbols are on screen, and the 'Just a quick chat' line honestly reflects the 'fully managed' caveat (the user still answers in the chat).
